html:
Rhinoplasty is one of the most popular surgeries that is performed today. There are several common reasons why individuals consider this surgical procedure. Some individuals deal with medical issues that cause them to seek rhinoplasty. A deviated septum is one of the most common reasons why a person would seek rhinoplasty for a medical reason. When a person is not able to breathe well through their nose, rhinoplasty can be performed in order to help them.

It is much more common for a person to seek rhinoplasty for cosmetic reasons. There is a very strong link between how a person looks and how they feel. The vast majority of our clients are interested in improving the way their nose looks in order to improve the way they feel. Many of our clients have experienced ridicule, bullying and low self-esteem because they have a nose that is very large, very small or is not well-proportioned with the rest of their facial features. While we do not encourage our clients to undergo plastic surgery in order to please others, we do understand that when you do not feel good about the way you look, you do not feel good about your overall life.

Many of our clients are interested in rhinoplasty because they have a hump on their nose. When they see their profile, they do not like it. They may have received ridicule when they were in school because of it. Now that they are an adult, they can finally do something about the problem.

If a person has a nose that is very large or very small, their face is not going to look well-proportioned. And hiding a nose that does not fit in with the rest of your features is virtually impossible. Your nose is right in the center of your face. It has a huge bearing on the way the rest of your face looks.

It is also common for clients to seek rhinoplasty because they experienced a broken nose or were involved in an accident that caused damage to their nose. A person may have what they consider to be a perfect nose before being involved in an accident and now it may be crooked or in some other way misshaped. Rhinoplasty can be used in order to fix these problems.

We invite you to schedule a consultation at Hanemann Plastic Surgery to learn more about rhinoplasty. We will listen closely to what it is that you do not like about your nose and then show you the different options we have available in order to help you improve your overall appearance. Contact our Baton Rouge office today to book an appointment.
